result:
I made live flows honor a reversed view order in the web flow list. I couldn't type-check or run tests (dependencies aren't installed and you asked me not to), so none of it has been run, and I didn't add a test.

I couldn't find a "reverse view order" option in the web UI. The only web-side notion of reversing is the sort state's `desc` flag. `view_order_reversed` appears only in the generated options file, with no use in the web code. So I treated "reversed with no sort column" as the case to fix. That state is newest-first, because there is no column to order by. Before this change, `desc` with no column was ignored, and flows were always added at the end of the view.

In `web/src/js/ducks/flows/index.ts`:
- **Live inserts:** when there is no sort column and `desc` is set, flows from `flows/add`, and flows that newly match the filter on `flows/update`, now go at the front of the view.
- **View rebuilds:** the initial fetch (`FLOWS_RECEIVE`), search-filter updates, and clearing the sort column now also build a reversed view in that state. This keeps the whole view newest-first, not just the live inserts.
- **Sort by column:** this path is unchanged. Sorting by a column already honored `desc` for live flows.

In `web/src/js/ducks/flows/_utils.ts`, `insertViewItem` takes an optional `prepend` flag that inserts at position 0 instead of searching for a sorted position.

I also could not find any way in the current header UI to reach "`desc` with no column" (a third click on a header goes back to unsorted, `desc: false`). If you meant something different by "reverse view order", tell me and I'll rework it.
